definitions.explanation: going somewhere and returning on the same day without staying overnight

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}りで{温泉|おんせん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the hot springs on a day trip.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}から{京都|きょうと}は{日帰|ひがえ}りできる。
examples.english: You can do a day trip from Tokyo to Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう}のプランを{立|た}てた。
examples.english: I made a plan for a day trip.

notes:
FORMS:
{日|ひ} (day) + {帰|かえ}り (returning) → returning the same day

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{旅行|りょこう} (day trip)
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{温泉|おんせん} (day-trip hot springs)
- {日帰|ひがえ}り{出張|しゅっちょう} (same-day business trip)
- {日帰|ひがえ}りツアー (day tour)

USAGE:
Often used with で: {日帰|ひがえ}りで{行|い}く (to go on a day trip)

RELATED WORDS:
- {泊|とま}りがけ (overnight stay)
- {一泊|いっぱく}{二日|ふつか} (one night, two days)
- {弾丸|だんがん}ツアー (whirlwind tour)
